title: 第023章 破纪录88倍终极暴击全场起飞第024章 一粒金丹吞入腹修为暴涨连破境
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
两兄妹离开后，苏辰也找了一处隐蔽之地，接着心念一动，意识沉入饲养空间。
苏辰心念一动，意识沉入山海灵虚界。
尸类栖地内，黑雾仍旧压在地面上。
黑土潮湿，踩上去发黏。空气里飘着一股尸腥味。
灰袍道人的尸体躺在尸栏中央，胸口那道剑伤还没有合拢。
伤口边缘残留着斩邪剑意烧出的焦黑痕迹，皮肉翻卷，黑红一片。
他虽然已经死了，可身上的血煞还没有彻底散开。
尤其是眉心处，隐约还缠着一缕阴冷鬼气。
苏辰盯着尸体，眼神一点点亮了起来。
这灰袍道人生前是实打实的法师中期！
有茅山根底，会五鬼道邪法，亲手布下五鬼血阵，还祭炼过鬼胎。
这种尸体，放进尸类栏位里，价值远不是之前那些邪修能比。
淡蓝色光幕浮现。
【检测到尸类生灵。】
【品质：绿色】
【所属栏位：尸】
【是否绑定？】
又是一个绿色饲养物！
苏辰一颗心变得激动起来，没有迟疑，手指点下。
“绑定。”

话音刚落，尸类栖地内的黑土震了一下。
嗤嗤嗤——
一缕缕灰白雾气从地底钻出，缠住灰袍道人的四肢和脖颈，又顺着伤口、七窍往体内钻。
灰袍道人僵硬的尸体猛地抽动。
他体内残留的血煞像被惊醒，沿着皮下经络乱窜。
可尸类栏位的力量压了下来，那些血煞刚翻起来，便被按回骨肉深处。
【绑定成功。】
【饲养物：无名尸体】
【品质：绿色】
【所属栏位：尸】
【进化度：0%】
【忠诚度：60】
【当前状态：饥饿】
【适宜投喂：尸血、血肉精华、煞气、邪气、阴属性灵药、丹药辅料等。】
看着面板上的信息，苏辰随即抬手一挥。
五鬼道几具邪修以及李月盈的尸体便落在尸类栖息地上。
其四个邪修身上，沾着淡淡的鬼气和邪气，身上的伤口大部分都已经结痂。
至于李月盈的尸体，则和他们有所不同。
她只是普通孕妇，没有邪修身上那种驳杂法力。
然而，她腹部那道被黑煞骨剑刺穿的伤口里，却残留着一股诡异的胎血气息。

苏辰蹲下身，目光落在她腹部。
那个鬼婴魂魄已经被剑意斩灭，胎煞也碎了。
可腹中死胎，被灰袍道人用邪法养了许久。
content_en:
After the two brothers and sisters left, Su Chen also found a hiding place, and then with a thought, his consciousness sank into the breeding space.
With a thought in Su Chen's mind, his consciousness sank into the spiritual world of mountains and seas.
In the corpse habitat, the black mist still pressed on the ground.
The black soil is moist and sticky when stepped on. There was a corpse smell in the air.
The body of the gray-robed Taoist lay in the center of the corpse column, with the sword wound on his chest not yet closed.
The edge of the wound still retains the scorch marks caused by the evil-killing sword intent, and the skin and flesh are rolled up and turned black and red.
Although he was dead, the blood evil on his body had not completely dissipated.
Especially between the eyebrows, there is still a faint ghostly aura lingering.
Su Chen stared at the corpse, his eyes lighting up little by little.
This gray-robed Taoist was a real mid-level mage during his lifetime!
He has a foundation in Maoshan, knows the evil ways of the Five Ghosts, laid out the Blood Formation of the Five Ghosts with his own hands, and even sacrificed and refined ghost fetuses.
This kind of corpse, put in the corpse slot, is far more valuable than the previous evil cultivators.
A light blue light curtain emerged.
[Corpse creature detected. 】
[Quality: Green]
[Official column: Corpse]
【Bind? 】
Another green feeder!
Su Chen's heart became excited, and he pointed with his finger without hesitation.
"Bind."
As soon as he finished speaking, the black soil in the corpse habitat shook.
Chi chi chi——
Wisps of gray-white mist emerged from the ground, entangled the gray-robed Taoist's limbs and neck, and then penetrated into the body along the wounds and seven orifices.
The stiff body of the gray-robed Taoist twitched violently.
The remaining blood in his body seemed to be awakened, running wildly along the subcutaneous meridians.
But the power of the corpse column suppressed it, and as soon as the blood demons were turned over, they were pushed back into the depths of their flesh and bones.
[Binding successful. 】
[Feed: Unnamed Corpse]
[Quality: Green]
[Official column: Corpse]
[Evolution degree: 0%]
【Loyalty: 60】
[Current status: Hungry]
[Suitable feeding: corpse blood, flesh and blood essence, evil spirits, evil spirits, yin elixirs, elixir auxiliary materials, etc. 】
Looking at the information on the panel, Su Chen immediately raised his hand and waved.
The corpses of several evil cultivators from the Five Ghost Path and Li Yueying fell on the corpse habitat.
The bodies of the four evil cultivators were covered with a touch of ghostly and evil energy, and most of the wounds on their bodies had scabbed over.
As for Li Yueying's body, it was different from them.
She is just an ordinary pregnant woman and does not have the mixed magic power of an evil cultivator.
However, there was a strange smell of fetal blood remaining in the wound on her abdomen that was pierced by the Black Evil Bone Sword.
Su Chen knelt down and looked at her abdomen.
The soul of the ghost baby has been killed by the sword, and the fetus has been shattered.
But the fetus was stillborn in the womb and was raised for a long time by the gray-robed Taoist using evil methods.
